subject: maths
question: If θ is an acute angle and cos θ = (11)/(17), what is the value of tan θ?
solution:
Given

cos θ = 11/17

Concept used

tan θ = P/B

cos θ = B/H

P2 + B2 = H2

Calculation

112 + P2 = 172

P2 = 289 - 121

P2 = 168

P = 2√42

tan θ = P/B = 2√42/11

The answer is **2√42/11.**
